hypothesis: An explicitly regularized, quantization-aware residual to shipped HCE generalizes better than the prior almost-unregularized from-scratch H4. A net-only control and non-advancing H8 probe separate training and capacity effects.

data.admission: Reuse h4_data.authenticate and all exact v1 audit pins/53-file closure, without altering the v1 contract or evidence. Same retained bytes and original role identities.
data.innerSplit: sha256(UTF8('chessy-h4-v2-inner-20260915') + one NUL byte 0x00 + UTF8(positionFamily)); integer first16 hex modulo5 ==0 is inner-validation; other families inner-training. Existing one-row-per-source-game admission and explicit group-disjoint assertions apply.
data.innerCaveat: New v2 neural fits do not see inner-validation labels. These rows were previously training data for v1 neural fits and the frozen expanded HCE; this is development selection, not a fresh experiment-wide holdout. Expanded HCE inner score is in-sample for that comparator.
data.outerCaveat: NNUE validation was exposed by v1; v2 reports it once after final model freeze as exploratory transfer, never as fresh confirmatory evidence.

training.optimizer: Adam; beta1=.9,beta2=.999,epsilon=1e-8; analytic float64 gradients; deterministic per-seed minibatch permutation; no optimizer restarts
training.schedule: cosine by epoch from epoch1 lr=.003 to epoch300 lr=.00015; refit uses the same 300-epoch schedule prefix
training.loss: mean BCEWithLogits(predicted_white_cp/100, teacher.targetWhite) + .5*lambda*sum((params-anchor)^2); no extra division by parameter count
training.anchor: Initial W1 and b1, zero W2 and b2. W1=N(0,.04),b1=.25; residual starts W2=b2=0; net-only starts W2=N(0,.1),b2=0.
training.baseline: Residual = frozen shipped HCE integer white cp + rounded neural white cp. No fixedCp or mopUpCp additive ablation; no refitting of either HCE comparator.
training.projection: after each update W1,b1 in[-1.9,1.9]; W2 in[-4,4]; b2 in[-2,2]
training.quantizationAwareMethod: Round W1/b1 at Q1,W2 at Q2,b2 at Q1*Q2 in forward; identity STE for rounding and CReLU interior derivative, no final-cp rounding in differentiable objective
training.checkpointEligibility: Only epochs210,220,...,300 after QAT starts. Choose lowest exact quantized inner-validation CE; exact ties choose earlier epoch. Retain all curves and chosen checkpoints.
training.retryPolicy: Canonical no-replace run marker before role decoding. No score-driven changes/retries; fatal errors preserve evidence and stop. Synthetic fixes before real execution permitted.

selection.recipe: Among three H4 configurations choose lowest median of three best quantized inner-validation CEs; ties by listed configuration order. H8 is a diagnostic capacity probe only and cannot be selected or open test.
selection.representativeSeed: Median best-inner-CE seed of the selected recipe; exact ties by seed. Never choose the luckiest seed.
selection.refit: Exactly one fresh full-shared-train fit of that fixed seed and recipe; epoch count is median of its three inner best epochs. Use original 300-epoch cosine prefix and QAT201. Keep final epoch, with no outer-selected checkpoint.
selection.freezeBeforeOuter: Publish no-replace recipe/seed/epochs decision and model digest before reading NNUE-validation performance. One outer candidate only, no reselection.
selection.qualityGuards: Reuse v1 guard against BOTH frozen comparators: >=0.5% relative CE gain; MAE/RMSE<=1.02x, p99<=1.05x; each phase>=100 rows and CE<=1.01x.
selection.noEligibleCandidate: Report all results and stop without test, runtime, new matches, data growth or level changes.

quantization.weights: int16 little-endian; biases int32; exact theoretical int32 accumulator/int64 output proofs for<=32pieces
quantization.rounding: weights nearest ties-even; floor((integer numerator*400+denominator/2)/denominator) then white sign; add shipped integer baseline only in residual mode
quantization.checks: Train, inner-validation, full-shared-train final, outer validation and seven authored special FENs; independent JavaScript BigInt parity for each selected inner checkpoint and final consumed roles.

test.condition: Only single frozen final H4 candidate passing outer quality, quantization, parity and size gates; same test-quality guards and v1 family-cluster bootstrap 2000 draws seed1050915, upper95 CE delta<0 vs both comparators
test.marker: Canonical no-replace test-opened state, keyed by v2 contract and original label-summary digest; consumed before test role decoding; renamed output cannot reopen
test.failure: No test-driven adjustment or further runs.

scope.deviceGate: #84 remains required before runtime integration; reference timing is not device/search timing
scope.formalAcceptance: #175 remains unfinished; no Elo or family-estimator acceptance inferred from offline loss
scope.publication: Only code, exact contract, weight-free reports and source research enter Git. Checkpoints/state remain separately preserved; no automatic new license for derived weights.
